decisions.description: Decide whether an already-contacted lead may receive scheduled follow-ups when its current category is null.
decisions.whyTheyDiffer: The legacy comparator gates template mode on current category/template availability before contacted scheduling; V2 treats sent history and contacted lifecycle as governing facts.
insufficientFacts: Whether follow-up content is already stored or category-neutral
The category or campaign used for the initial send
Why the current category is null

options.label: Continue contacted sequence
options.description: Allow follow-ups from sent history regardless of current category.

options.label: Require category or manual review
options.description: Exclude null-category follow-up sends until categorized or reviewed.

options.label: Require preserved or neutral context
options.description: Continue only with preserved campaign/template context or approved category-neutral content.

decisions.longTermSaasImplication: Persist send-time campaign/template identity and support an explicit tenant or campaign continuation policy.
decisions.unblockCondition: An enforceable canary cohort restriction or policy must prevent null-category follow-up execution.

decisions.description: Decide whether an already-contacted lead may be reactivated after 60 days when its current category is null.
decisions.whyTheyDiffer: The legacy comparator returns on current template availability before reactivation scheduling; V2 gives completed sequence history and the approved initial-send-based schedule precedence.
insufficientFacts: Whether reactivation has a safe null-category fallback
Why the current category is null

options.label: Permit reactivation
options.description: Allow reactivation from historical sequence facts regardless of current category.

options.label: Require category or preserved context
options.description: Exclude or review null-category reactivations until content provenance is known.

options.label: Disable reactivation broadly
options.description: Use tenant-wide disablement for the canary, accepting that this is not category-specific and may lead to MARK_DEAD.

decisions.longTermSaasImplication: Provide an explicit tenant or campaign reactivation policy backed by preserved campaign context or approved neutral content.
decisions.unblockCondition: An enforceable canary cohort restriction or policy must prevent null-category reactivation execution.

decisions.description: Confirm that template readiness must not automatically regenerate initial content for an already-contacted lead.
decisions.whyTheyDiffer: The legacy comparator's template branch returns before recognizing contacted lifecycle state; V2 gives the already-sent initial and contacted sequence precedence.

options.label: Preserve V2 lifecycle ordering
options.description: Never automatically regenerate an initial email after contact.

options.label: Operator-only regeneration
options.description: Allow explicit audited repair or regeneration outside automatic next-action selection.

options.label: Reproduce legacy ordering
options.description: Automatically regenerate for contacted template-ready leads, risking duplicate or stale drafts.

decisions.longTermSaasImplication: Lifecycle truth should outrank mutable template readiness; regeneration should be a separate audited operator operation.
decisions.unblockCondition: No runtime unblock is needed because all four V2 actions are WAIT.

PD-01.rule: Due follow-ups require usable category context.

PD-02.rule: Due reactivation requires usable category context.

PD-03.rule: Contacted leads never automatically regenerate initial outreach.

usableCategoryContext.derivation: A non-null leads.category_id whose already-loaded categories FK relation resolves.

canaryReadiness.configurationDescription: A curated or explicitly gated canary can exclude null-category contacted leads from follow-up and reactivation execution while preserving the approved Decision Engine and Orchestrator architecture.
canaryReadiness.existingSettingsLimitation: Available global quotas, delays, and reactivation disablement are not category-specific and may suppress unrelated leads or produce MARK_DEAD.
canaryReadiness.prompt16StartCondition: Prompt 15.6 safety gate is satisfied; Prompt 16 still requires its own launch controls and explicit authorization.
